description: CacheRelay unified operations board. Service health first, then RED, admission/streaming, JVM, data tier, and Prometheus health. Health signals never fake zeros: absence renders as No data or red, never green. Deep-dive dashboards are one click away in the links menu.

links.title: Deep Dives
links.tooltip: Open a focused dashboard (JVM, SSE, data tier, Prometheus health)

panels.description: Gateway scrape liveness (up{job="cacherelay"}). Absence renders as No data — never a fake green zero.
panels.title: Gateway

panels.description: JVM process uptime since last start.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: All HTTP requests per second across every endpoint (templated URI dimension).
panels.title: Requests/s

panels.description: 5xx responses as a percentage of all requests. Any value above zero is red; absence renders No data.
panels.title: 5xx %

panels.description: Requests rejected by the token-bucket rate limiter (HTTP 429).
panels.title: 429/s

panels.description: Providers whose circuit breaker is OPEN (cacherelay_circuit_breaker_state == 1). No value means every breaker is closed.
panels.title: Breakers

panels.description: Percentage of Redis tiers reachable by their exporters (accounting + cache). Red when below 100%.
panels.title: Redis

panels.description: Postgres exporter reachability (pg_up). Down or absent renders DOWN/No data — never a green zero.
panels.title: Postgres

panels.description: Latency percentiles from the http.server.requests histogram (templated URIs). P99 over a 5m window for a stable tail at low traffic.
panels.title: Latency P50 / P95 / P99

panels.description: Request rate split by outcome class (SUCCESS / REDIRECTION / CLIENT_ERROR / SERVER_ERROR).
panels.title: Request Rate by Outcome

panels.description: Request rate by HTTP status code as observed on the templated URI dimension.
panels.title: Requests by Status

panels.description: Rate-limit evaluations per second by decision. NOTE: one evaluation per chat / embedding / MCP-call / A2A-message request; models, admin, auth, and health paths never evaluate by design (unmetered). At idle traffic, flat zero is correct.
panels.title: Rate-Limit Evaluations by Decision

panels.description: Denied evaluations as a percentage of all evaluations, with a minimum-sample guard so idle traffic cannot paint a meaningful 0%. Matches the RateLimitDenySpike alert at 5%.
panels.title: Deny Rate % (min 10 evals)

panels.description: Currently open SSE streams. Zero at idle is expected.
panels.title: SSE Connections

panels.description: Maximum observed SSE flush lag (matches the SseFlushLagSpike alert at 250ms).
panels.title: Flush Lag

panels.description: Warning and error log events per second (logback_events_total). On-call signal: any sustained error rate deserves triage before it cascades.
panels.title: Log Events (warn / error)

panels.description: Heap used as a percentage of max heap (Xmx 1152m). Yellow at 70%, red at 80% per the ZGC allocation-pacing risk band.
panels.title: Heap %

panels.description: Direct buffer memory against the 256 MB MaxDirectMemorySize cap. Red at 80% per the JvmDirectMemoryHigh alert.
panels.title: Direct %

panels.description: Virtual threads currently mounted or queued. Demand-driven: zero at idle is expected.
panels.title: VThreads

panels.description: Live platform threads (JVM total).
panels.title: PThreads

panels.description: ZGC major pause p99 over 10m windows (live measured ~1ms). Red above the GcPauseHigh threshold of 200ms.
panels.title: ZGC p99

panels.description: HikariCP connections currently checked out. Yellow above 85% of the pool max (the HikariPoolNearExhaustion alert).
panels.title: DB Active

panels.description: Threads waiting for a database connection. Anything above zero is the HikariPoolThreadsPending critical alert.
panels.title: DB Wait

panels.description: Ledger executor queue depth. The LedgerQueueGrowing alert fires above 50K pending.
panels.title: Ledger

panels.description: Redis per-tier reachability (redis_up). Absence renders No data — never a fake green zero.
panels.title: Redis Up by Tier

panels.description: Redis memory used as a percentage of maxmemory per tier. Accounting red above 80%: under noeviction a full tier fails writes.
panels.title: Redis Memory %

panels.description: Key evictions in the last hour per tier. Accounting evictions are critical; cache evictions are normal LRU pressure. Renders No data until evictions occur.
panels.title: Redis Evictions 1h

panels.description: Redis main-thread CPU utilization per tier (fraction of one core). The RedisMainThreadSaturation alert fires at 0.9.
panels.title: Redis CPU

panels.description: Postgres buffer cache hit ratio for the ledger database. Below 99% is the PostgresBufferHitLow alert. Red base: absence means the exporter is blind, not healthy.
panels.title: PG Buffer Hit %

panels.description: Active Postgres backends against the max_connections ceiling (200). Yellow at 60%, red at 80%.
panels.title: PG Connections %

panels.description: Redis commands processed per second per tier (accounting carries rate limits, budgets, holds, dedupe, breakers; cache carries lookups and vectors).
panels.title: Redis Command Throughput by Tier

panels.description: Redis memory used over time per tier alongside each tier's maxmemory cap line.
panels.title: Redis Memory vs Cap by Tier

panels.description: Postgres transaction commit and rollback rates for the ledger database.
panels.title: PG Transaction Rate

panels.description: Healthy scrape targets as a fraction of all targets across every pool.
panels.title: Targets Healthy %

panels.description: Total active series Prometheus is storing (head + blocks).
panels.title: Head Series

panels.description: Actual scrape duration per target job. The postgres job was pinned at the 3s scrape timeout — if a line reaches 3s, that scrape fails.
panels.title: Scrape Duration by Job

panels.description: Token generation rate by provider, model, and direction (cacherelay_tokens_total).
panels.title: Token Rate by Provider / Model / Type

panels.description: Cache lookups by level: hit_l0 = exact, hit_l1 = semantic, miss = upstream call. Absence renders No data; never replaced with a fabricated zero.
panels.title: Cache Lookups by Level

panels.description: Budget admission evaluations by decision. Renders No data until the gateway emits cacherelay_budget_evaluations_total with a decision label.
panels.title: Budget Evaluations by Decision

panels.description: Cost burn rate by provider. Pending backend instrumentation: this panel renders No data until cacherelay_cost_micros_total is emitted once per ledger-committed request.
panels.title: Cost Burn Rate by Provider ($/hr)
